title: Irreducible tensor product modules over the Takiff Lie algebra for $\mathfrak{sl}_{2}$
summary: In this paper, we construct a class of non-weight modules over the Takiff $\mathfrak{sl}_{2}$ by taking the tensor products of the irreducible free $U(\overline{\mathfrak{h}})$-modules of rank 1, where $\overline{\mathfrak{h}}$ is a natural Cartan subalgebra of the Takiff $\mathfrak{sl}_{2}$, with the irreducible highest weight modules. We characterize the irreducibility of these tensor product modules and determine the necessary and sufficient conditions for isomorphisms between them.
